ClientResponses.Response:
Hello. We are very sorry to see that your grill has corroded. If your grill is located in a coastal or humid area, or if chlorine is present in your environment, additional maintenance will be needed to keep up the appearance of the exterior steel parts. Below are a couple helpful tips.

1. At the first sign of staining/discoloration/surface rust we would recommend cleaning with a stainless steel cleaner. Once cleaned, we recommend using a stainless steel polish (ex. Weber's brand) to keep it looking its best in-between cleanings.

2. Once a week we would recommend wiping down the grill with a wet towel or rag and then drying completely.

3. We would only recommend covering your grill if you know inclement weather is coming. 

4. The quicker you get at a stain the easier it will be to clean off.

We do see that you reached out to our support team, and that replacement parts are on the way. Thank you for being part of the Weber family!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

A great grill, we recommend it highly.

ClientResponses.Response:
Hello! We are sorry to hear about the issue you are experiencing with the grill reaching temperature. To ensure that you are not inadvertently activating the safety device as you turn on the grill, please use the following procedure:

-Turn all burner control knobs to OFF, including the side burner control knob if present.

-Make sure the grill lid is open. Open the LP tank valve and then wait at least 60 seconds. This will allow the hose and regulator to pressurize.

-Turn the appropriate burner control knob for your model grill to the START/HIGH position and then ignite the grill by pushing the ignition button.

-Turn each of the other burner control knobs to high, one at a time, and press the igniter button (if applicable for your model). Repeat this process until all the burners have been lit.

-Close the grill lid.

-The grill should reach approximately 500 to 550 degrees in 10-15 minutes.

If you still experience an issue after going through the following steps please contact our support team for further assistance. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.
